dedupe_keys.name: road network with roadscape vectors in awaji island japan

description: Kenta Oku and Koji Kawamata at Ryukoku University publish an Awaji Island road graph with landscape attributes. Zenodo supplies three tab-separated CSV files free under CC BY-SA 4.0. The documented network has 102,506 nodes and 212,050 directed links derived from OpenStreetMap. Node records provide coordinates, link records identify endpoints, and a separate table assigns probabilities for rural, mountainous, waterside and urban scenery. These inputs can test landscape-sensitive route choices in transport simulations. Related catalogue record data-openstreetmap describes the source database. Coverage is Awaji Island, Japan, with extraction date and coordinate datum not fully established in the deposit. Roadscape probabilities are model attributes, not observed traveller preferences, and traffic capacities are not supplied by the described schema. Annotation uncertainty and graph completeness remain unverified. No tables were downloaded or route recommendations reproduced.
